description: Get a real number from the database and return it to the user in the chat. metric_type: count (number of records), sum (sum of a number field), average (average), new_today (records added today), updated_today (records updated today), growth (the current period compared with the previous one; needs date_field and compare_period). entity_id can be a form ID or a report ID (with its filter).

compare_period.description: For metric_type=growth: today_vs_yesterday | this_week_vs_last | this_month_vs_last | this_quarter_vs_last | this_year_vs_last

date_field.description: Name or ID of the date field (required for growth). 'created_at' or 'updated_at' can be passed for the system fields.

entity_id.description: Form ID or report ID — for a report, the metric counts only the filtered records

metric_type.description: count | sum | average | new_today | updated_today | growth

value_field.description: Name or ID of the number field (required for sum and average)

name: get_metric
